To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(i) the combination of model checking and ATP is a promising approach for the practical application of deduction-based component retrieval and (ii) that the precision and recall of our approach is competitive with other approaches for software component retrieval.

- the chain of filters is a promising concept to make deduction-based retrieval practical - a combination of model checking and theorem proving techniques can be used for a very effective chain of filters - our approach can retrieve components that are not found by other retrieval techniques.

(i) the use of rejection filters in a retrieval chain is very promising; (ii) the use of a model checker as a first rejection filter is very promising; and (iii) the use of an ATP as a final confirmation filter is very promising.
